source_text: PubMed abstract only (no full text available) plus GEO series summary/overall design and the authors' deposited DESeq2 table GSE221894_PostLean-PreLean_rawDE-v2.xls.gz
assay: bulk RNA-seq, vastus lateralis biopsy, Illumina NextSeq 2000 100bp SE, salmon v1.4.0 (GEO data_processing)
sample_inclusion: 15 sedentary normal-weight adults started, 14 completed 7 HIIT sessions over 14 days; biopsies before and 48 h after the last session (abstract)
primary_estimand: within-person change in vastus lateralis gene expression from before to 48 h after 2 weeks (7 sessions) of HIIT
repeated_measure_unit: participant (pre and post biopsy from the same person)
planned_contrasts: post-HIIT vs pre-HIIT (abstract: transcripts that increased/decreased with HIIT; GEO deposited table PostLean-PreLean)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.32.0 on salmon quantifications (GEO data_processing); exact design formula (paired or not) not stated in the abstract
paper_results: abstract: increased transcripts enriched for mitochondrial respiration gene sets (especially complex I); decreased transcripts enriched for DNA and chromatin remodelling pathways; no DEG count given. Deposited authors' table: 35 genes padj<0.05 (19 up, 16 down) among 5944 genes listed (all baseMean>140).
